title: The Rent Tower Watcher over the sealed strongroom

approval.notes: The watcher identity, the farmed rent dispute, the enemy composition, and the outcomes are gameplay authorship. The tower is attested only as present on the north-west circuit before the mid fourteenth century, so the closed rectangular interior stays a reversible minimum-claim reconstruction.

source_notes.summary: The Rent Tower Watcher, the farmed dues, and the sealed-tally stand-down are authored encounter identities, not attested occupants or events.
The encounter separates a crossbow-shaped watcher in the counting chamber from a hired strongarm on the strongroom floor below.
